notes:
Zone (verified in the model). First-floor plan, the balcony's calibration (X = −18.8 + px·0.029984, Y = 7.83 − (py−187)·0.030273). Ray casts and horizontal sections of the GLB (survey.png): hall X −5.28..+3.82, Y +1.24..+7.80 (9.1 × 6.6 m) and the lobby X −1.80..+0.55 to Y −3.16; floor 2.44 m; soffit 5.00 m everywhere (tile ceiling here at 4.95, 2.51 m clear); the four small rooms to the south are excluded. Doors and openings: balcony door X −2.40..+0.80 in the north glazing; west wall Y 1.9..2.9 and 5.25..6.55 (the Kitchen, behind the counter); east wall Y 1.9..3.6 (Founder Space 2 side); UJ Connect X −3.90..−2.70; the lobby leads south. Stair opening X 1.0..3.4, Y 0.3..1.35: the upper flight rises plan-west from the 1.60 m landing and arrives in the lobby at about (0.7, 0.75) — the orange block on the plan.

Photos. 137–139 the hall looking plan-west, 140/141 looking plan-south (tiers, partition, stair), 142/143 serving counter and feature wall, 145 behind the counter, 147 the SparkLab wall, 150/151 the partition and buffet, 152/153 the stair opening with planters, 197/200 the stair with the wall art. 112 is NOT the Cafeteria (it looks down another stair into a ground-floor office) — not used. People ignored.

Built as new objects. 400 mm glazed floor tiles; salmon paint (grey on the SparkLab wall) with tile skirting; 600 mm lay-in ceiling with grey grid; 16 teal cone pendants, two black track lines with spots, a black-and-brass cluster pendant over the stair, camera-invisible room fill; 4 dining tables and 24 slatted chairs as collection instances; a counter with a quartz top, corrugated front and glass display case; wood feature wall with an ‘A’ shelf and menu board; coffee station; bins; buffet table with an orange pleated skirt and purple runner; three coloured seating tiers; SparkLab doodle board, wheels and lettering; glazed office partition and door on UJ Connect; doors in the model openings; stair balustrade (steel + wood rail); painted troughs with snake plants; wall art; clock, posters, fire exit sign, extinguisher cabinet.

Differences from the photos. (1) The real hall is larger and denser (about 10 tables); the model hall is 9.1 × 6.6 m, so 4 tables with 1.4 m aisles fit — the rest were dropped rather than squeezed. (2) The model's stair opening is 2.4 × 1.05 m; the photographed one is much larger, so the stair views are tighter. (3) Ceiling 2.51 m in the model vs about 3 m real. (4) The view through the glazing is the Balcony + Outside scenes.
